row.problem_statement:
Setting config options through attribute access raises OptionError

#### Description

When trying to set configuration options using attribute access on the options object, an OptionError is raised even for existing options.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import pandas as pd

# Register a simple option
pd._config.config.register_option('test_option', 0)

# Try to set it using attribute access
options = pd._config.config.options
options.test_option = 500  # This should work but raises OptionError
```

The error message is:
```
OptionError: You can only set the value of existing options
```

This happens even though 'test_option' is a valid, existing option that can be set using `pd.set_option('test_option', 500)`.

The attribute access method for setting options appears to be broken and always raises the OptionError regardless of whether the option exists or not.
